description: A beekeeper with one healthy nucleus colony must decide whether to sell it to a prospective buyer and finalize the price, pickup, and transport terms after consulting a local beekeeping mentor.

shared_context.S1: Ruth has one healthy nucleus colony available for sale at the Saturday farmers market.
shared_context.S2: Ruth will make the final decision about whether to sell the colony and will set the verbal terms.
shared_context.S3: Dylan has expressed interest in buying the colony, and Mei regularly helps local beekeepers check practical arrangements for moving colonies.
shared_context.S4: Ruth's usual practice before selling a live colony is to ask the prospective buyer and the consulting beekeeper to confirm the price, timing, and transport arrangements.

PF1.text: Dylan is prepared to pay exactly $275, can collect the colony on Saturday at 8:00 a.m., and will take it directly to his apiary; he has not yet stated these exact terms.

PF2.text: Mei knows from the county apiary inspector that this colony must be transported in a screened nuc box with every frame secured upright, rather than in an open crate or loose-frame container.

acceptance_conditions: The colony must be sold to Dylan for exactly $275.
Dylan must collect the colony on Saturday at 8:00 a.m.
The colony must be transported in a screened nuc box.
Every frame must be secured upright for transport.
A transport-safety commitment naming the screened nuc box and secured upright frames must be recorded.
The final decision must cite Mei's transport information and Dylan's exact offer.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'transport_safety' and c['target'] == 'Dylan' and c['detail'] == 'screened nuc box with every frame secured upright' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Dylan's exact offer changes the settlement to Dylan as buyer, exactly $275, and Saturday at 8:00 a.m. rather than an unspecified buyer, price, or pickup time.
The inspector's transport requirement changes the colony's handling from an unspecified container to a screened nuc box with every frame secured upright and creates the matching safety commitment.
